verified via Showdown source (moves.ts): Silk Trap calls checkMoveBypassesProtect(move, source, target, false) — the blockStatus=false path, unlike Protect/Detect/Spiky Shield/Baneful Bunker's blockStatus=true default — so status-category moves are never blocked here, only damaging ones. Matches Bulbapedia's phrasing ('protects the user from physical and special moves') vs. Protect's broader 'from moves' wording. Same blockStatus=false shape as King's Shield/Mat Block.
